items.source: Return the list of media types supported by this converter. The list may not apply to every possible target element type and calls to this method should typically be guarded via canWrite(clazz, null. The list may also exclude MIME types supported only for a specific class. Alternatively, use getSupportedMediaTypes(Class) for a more precise list.
items.translation: 返回此转换器支持的媒体类型列表。该列表可能不适用于所有可能的目标元素类型，因此调用此方法时通常应通过 canWrite(clazz, null 进行保护。该列表也可能仅排除特定类支持的 MIME 类型。或者，使用 getSupportedMediaTypes(Class) 获取更精确的列表。

items.source: Return the list of media types supported by this converter for the given class. The list may differ from getSupportedMediaTypes() if the converter does not support the given Class or if it supports it only for a subset of media types.
items.translation: 返回此转换器针对给定类支持的媒体类型列表。如果转换器不支持给定的 Class，或者仅支持其子集，则该列表可能与getSupportedMediaTypes()不同。

items.source: Indicates whether the given class can be read by this converter.
items.translation: 指示该转换器是否可以读取给定的类。

items.source: Indicates whether the given class can be written by this converter.
items.translation: 指示该转换器是否可以写入给定类。

items.source: Read an object of the given type from the given input message, and returns it.
items.translation: 从给定的输入消息中读取给定类型的对象，并返回它。

items.source: Write a given object to the given output message.
items.translation: 将给定对象写入给定的输出消息中。

items.source: contentType - the content type to use when writing. May be null to indicate that the default content type of the converter must be used. If not null, this media type must have previously been passed to the canWrite method of this interface, which must have returned true.
items.translation: contentType - 写入时使用的内容类型。若为 null，表示必须使用转换器默认的内容类型。若非 null，此媒体类型必须已先前传递给该接口的 canWrite 方法，且该方法必须返回 true。

items.source: clazz - the type of object to return. This type must have previously been passed to the canRead method of this interface, which must have returned true.
items.translation: clazz - 要返回的对象类型。此类型必须先前已传递给该接口的canRead方法，且该方法必须返回true。

items.source: t - the object to write to the output message. The type of this object must have previously been passed to the canWrite method of this interface, which must have returned true.
items.translation: t - 要写入输出消息的对象。该对象的类型必须先前已传递给此接口的canWrite方法，且该方法必须返回true。

items.source: IOException - in case of I/O errors
items.translation: `IOException` - 在发生 I/O 错误时

items.source: Strategy interface for converting from and to HTTP requests and responses.
items.translation: 用于将 HTTP 请求和响应进行转换的策略接口。

items.source: Return the list of media types supported by this converter.
items.translation: 返回此转换器支持的媒体类型列表。

items.source:
Return the list of media types supported by this converter for the given
class.
items.translation: 返回此转换器针对给定类支持的媒体类型列表。

items.source: mediaType - the media type to read (can be null if not specified); typically the value of a Content-Type header.
items.translation: `mediaType` - 要读取的媒体类型（如果未指定，可以为 `null`）；通常是 `Content-Type` 标头的值。

items.source: mediaType - the media type to write (can be null if not specified); typically the value of an Accept header.
items.translation: `mediaType` - 要写入的媒体类型（如果未指定，可以为 `null`）；通常是 `Accept` 头的值。

items.source: T - the converted object type
items.translation: T - 转换后的对象类型

items.source: true if readable; false otherwise
items.translation: true 表示可读；否则为 false。

items.source: true if writable; false otherwise
items.translation: true 表示可写；否则为 false。

items.source: HttpMessageNotReadableException - in case of conversion errors
items.translation: HttpMessageNotReadableException - 在转换错误时

items.source: HttpMessageNotWritableException - in case of conversion errors
items.translation: HttpMessageNotWritableException - 在转换错误时

items.source: clazz - the class to test for readability
items.translation: clazz - 要测试可读性的类

items.source: clazz - the class to test for writability
items.translation: clazz - 要测试可写性的类

items.source: clazz - the type of class to check
items.translation: clazz - 要检查的类类型

items.source: inputMessage - the HTTP input message to read from
items.translation: inputMessage - 要读取的 HTTP 输入消息

items.source: outputMessage - the message to write to
items.translation: outputMessage - 要写入的消息。
